findings.highlight: crosses the dozens of meters from the top of the hill
findings.evidenceJa: 何十メートルという距離を一息で落下してくる
findings.governingReading: drops the dozens of meters from the top of the hill in a single plunge
findings.explanation: Berserker’s vertical descent becomes a horizontal leap, changing the opening attack geometry.

findings.highlight: silver lights that are shooting through the giant
findings.evidenceJa: 巨体を射抜いていく銀光
findings.governingReading: silver streaks shooting into/at the giant’s descending body
findings.explanation: The English implies the arrows have penetrated Berserker immediately before the scene reveals that they had no effect.

findings.evidenceJa: 岩盤すら穿ちかねない
findings.explanation: The individual arrows’ stated destructive benchmark is reduced from a rock mass or bedrock to ordinary rocks.

findings.evidenceJa: 家の一つや二つは容易く蜂の巣にする
findings.governingReading: could easily riddle one or two houses with holes
findings.explanation: The image of perforating houses with repeated shots becomes the unrelated action of mowing them down.

findings.highlight: Berserker, who came down through a rain of ‘arrows’
findings.evidenceJa: “矢”をその身に受けながらも落下したバーサーカー
findings.governingReading: Berserker, who landed despite taking the “arrows” into his body
findings.explanation: The English replaces direct bodily hits with movement through a generalized rain of arrows, weakening the evidence of his invulnerability.

findings.highlight: faces the assault of that giant sword head-on
findings.evidenceJa: 真っ正面から切り崩していく
findings.governingReading: cuts the giant sword’s assault down head-on
findings.explanation: Saber’s active dismantling of the incoming swordwork disappears, reducing her displayed technique to merely facing it.

findings.evidenceJa: 飛ばされ、アスファルトを滑るセイバー
findings.governingReading: Saber is flung away and slides across the asphalt
findings.explanation: The first stage of Berserker’s counterattack, bodily launching Saber, is omitted.

findings.evidenceJa: 悉く巨人の体に敗れ去った
findings.governingReading: were all defeated by the giant’s body
findings.explanation: The English invents disappearance instead of stating that the precisely placed arrows fail against Berserker’s body.

findings.highlight: blocks the giant blade with her own
findings.evidenceJa: 咄嗟に剣で受け止める
findings.governingReading: instinctively catches the giant blade on her sword
findings.explanation: The emergency, reflexive nature of Saber’s block is removed.
The English loses Saber’s new position, obscuring the combatants’ movement up the hill.

findings.highlight: flung away like a balland she falls
findings.evidenceJa: ボールのように弾き飛ばされだん、と
findings.governingReading: flung away like a ball and lands with a thud
findings.explanation: A missing word boundary produces visibly malformed English at the climax of the exchange.

findings.highlight: scatters obsidian jewels in the sky
findings.evidenceJa: 黒曜石を中空にばらまく
findings.governingReading: scatters pieces of obsidian into the air
findings.explanation: The English promotes obsidian stones into jewels without support.

findings.highlight: Saber bravely blocks it with her sword
findings.evidenceJa: 凛々しい視線のまま剣で受け止め
findings.governingReading: Saber catches it on her sword without losing her gallant, resolute gaze
findings.explanation: A specific visual sign of Saber’s composure is replaced by a generic adverb, weakening characterization under overwhelming force.

findings.highlight: plows into the open terrain off the road
findings.evidenceJa: 坂道から外れた荒れ地へと叩き込まれた
findings.governingReading: is smashed into the wasteland off the slope
findings.explanation: The violent impact and barren landing ground are both softened.

findings.highlight: this monster that is unscathed by all those attacks
findings.evidenceJa: あれだけやって無傷だった相手
findings.governingReading: the opponent left unscathed after all that
findings.explanation: The English inserts “monster” into Shirou’s thought where the source neutrally says opponent.
